question: Who beats us on Gemini, and which sources do they get cited from?
answer: Threadline (12.5%), Rang Bazaar (11.1%), and Silk Route Studio (9.7%) are the brands that rank first on Gemini ahead of Lahore Loom (40.3%). In answers where Lahore Loom does not win, the competitors' own domains — threadline.pk (37.5%), rangbazaar.pk (33.3%), silkroutestudio.pk (29.2%) — are cited, while they appear in 0% of winning answers. Third‑party sources also differ: daraz.pk shows up in 62.5% of losses versus 41.4% of wins, youtube.com in 33.3% vs 27.6%, and lahorestyleguide.pk in 20.8% vs 13.8%.
action: Pitch a product listing or brand feature to daraz.pk this week to gain citations on the domain that appears in 62.5% of losing Gemini answers.

evidence.sql: SELECT winner, COUNT(*) AS answers_ranked_first, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers WHERE engine = 'gemini'), 1) AS pct_of_answers FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers WHERE engine = 'gemini' AND winner NOT IN ('Kurta Co') GROUP BY winner ORDER BY answers_ranked_first DESC LIMIT 200

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT a.result_id,
         a.run_date,
         a.engine,
         a.status
  FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers a
  WHERE a.engine = 'gemini'
    AND a.winner <> 'Kurta Co'
),
answer_domains AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.result_id,
         f.run_date,
         f.status,
         s.domain
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN GLISPER_DEMO.answer_sources s
    ON f.result_id = s.result_id
   AND f.run_date = s.run_date
   AND f.engine = s.engine
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_not_won
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, status FROM filtered) t
),
domain_stats AS (
  SELECT
    domain,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_citations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_won_citations
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, status, domain FROM answer_domains) d
  GROUP BY domain
)
SELECT
  ds.domain,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.not_won_citations / t.total_not_won, 1) AS not_won_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.won_citations / t.total_won, 1) AS won_pct
FROM domain_stats ds
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE t.total_not_won > 0 AND t.total_won > 0
ORDER BY not_won_pct DESC, won_pct ASC LIMIT 200
